translation.name: Yoac kekehagocac Dzadzahac gboria nga Mitiyegec

book.name: ROMA
book.title: Paurongo Roma Kpebung Yeneac Kibi Ohoec

content: Ngicngac Kebu negensinggema seria nandimbe, nenang kucmama kecdae, yeneac ebic serima tofohoma nenanggacsac negemma meficemema mi kecbisina.
Amma nenang tembuc tembuc ngicngac wegena kecdae, yeni ngereegecdeac nga yeni Kebu negensinggema yadiseri anggecdeac kingang kpeyemmebisina.
Kristongo ifingoc yengenaac ngereeudeac ua mi meec, kpac. Yeng faka anec imoc yofi oho ohoya fede,

content.text: “Desusuic areng yeni desusuic anggenggec, imocngo neac witiu enec.” (Mitiyegec 69:9)

content: Mitikibiu warac wiac sasawa ohodacgec, imoc nenang edekpou anemmegecdeac oho ohoya fede. Yoac negenni imocngo meserinunuma nanggenunuu wiac fingecnemmeude, imoc negenseridimbe.
Amma Anutungo modzotitia kpac nga nangge nangge minginango meficngunumanu ngeni Yesu Kristoac negen negeng modacgec negen negengngina mocgu ambeso.
Ifi amma ngeni ngenahafoc enacurecfu Kebunina Yesu Kristoac Anutu nga Manggac dengeregecde.
Nga Anutuac kpac kuneng fingerudeac negemma Kristongo hoangngunuec, ifi isocngoc ngeni hoangemebisia.
Ni yofi edengunuduae, Anutungo warac bangecfocnina yenigoc yoac dedzege anec. Nga Kristongo Anutuac yoac fora meseriudeac sebi tosangina herec herecgea yeneac kingang kpekpe anec.
Ifi anu bangec monnunac ngicngac, yeneng ifingoc Anutu wosoefahaac amma dengeregec. Imocac yofi oho ohoya fede,

content.text: “Imocac ni bangeha bangeha ngicngac areng tosea, yeneac botucfu dengereguma yegecfu kpacga afehebade.” (2 Samue 22:50; Mitiyegec 18:49)

content: Amma monggoc yofi dede,

content.text: “Bangec monnunac ngicngac, ngeneng yeac ngicngac arengforagoc kpeturanggema ngenahafoc sogaibisia.” (Dedeseri 32:43)

content: Amma mong yofi,

content.text: “Bangec monnunac ngicngac, ngeni KEBU fendzonggema dengerebisia. Ngiha ngiha sasawa ngeni KEBU afehebisia.” (Mitiyegec 117:1)

content: Nga Yesaiango torokpema yofi dede,

content.text: “Isaiac godeaarunac sera mongngo fingecma bangec monnunac ngicngac, yeneac ngictaungina amma garengyunuu yeneng ye negensinggema kecgecde.” (Yesaia 11:10)

content: Anutungo kekecseriac dedepang faiec, ye negensinggegec yeac sogac sogai nga ruae hafoangoc mewakengunubeso. Imoc mewakengunuu Tiri Asungo nanggengunuu kekecseriac dedepangngo ubanegen negengnginau sokongunubeso.
Tosofocna, ngeni ngenaoc wiac gombunga arenggegec nga negen negeng sasawa imocngo mewakengunuu ngenaocngoc gorongina naric kpeemegecde, fakangina ifia fede, imoc negenseriyombonggeduae.
Ni ifi negemma kengeha kpac kecma yoac goa heigboringemmema ohoduae, imoc Anutungo wosoefac nga kuc nenecac anduae.

Ifi amma Yesu Kristoac kingangkpekpe kecma bangec monnunac ngicngac botucnginau Anutuac kicfu womonggareng kecma ua kpetiac mekecma yeac siduc gombunggac ua mekecduae. Mekecba Tiri Asungo bangeha bangeha ngicngac areng tosea, yeni Anutuac sese dema kpetiac meyunuu Anutungo yeneac negenu ngereede.
Ni Anutuac kicfu kingang kpekpe uaya mekecma Yesu Kristogoc kpeketahema kecduae, imoc negemba engena yombong anu naric deduae.
Kristongo dafiu kuc nenu neng bangec monnunac ngicngac yenearu kemma yeac yoac dema uaya meba yoara modacgec, imoc mi dekperagiyemmebaiu imocngo ebiribac.

Imoc Anutuac Asu yeac kucfu fingerec, yeac kucfaka hania hania morora hemma yoara modacgec. Ni siriha ifia Yerusarennu hanahema bangec noboc noboc mekengkecma Iririkong prowinsiu wisickeu Kristoac siduc gombung dekperagiyemmedarai.

Amma amabangec goau Kristoac kpacsiduc bic negenggec, yenearu siduc gombung mong mi edeyunukefai, imocac negemba ngereede. Imoc yofiac, ngic mongngo wotung bic ukuec, imocac witiau ua mebadeac mi anende.
Imocac yoac bic oho ohoya fede,

content.text: “Yeac kpacsiduc mong mi dekperagiyemmegec, areng imoc yeneng hentegecgecde. Nga ngicngac kedzacnginango yeac kpacsiduc mi negenggec, yeneng imoc negentegecgecde.” (Yesaia 52:15)

content: Imocac amma naso homac sinnau kpae fingeru ngenearu mi hayai.
Nga yofinenggac uana bangec yomohai bic mesiba wisickeec. Amma ngenearu habadeac kifa homac songona bic anec.
Imocac Spania bangecfu kembade,
naso imohai ngenembeso negenduae. Amma ngenigoc ewacma songona imohai mesimaguc Spania bangecfu kembeso deba ngeneng ni meficnugecdeac negenduae.
Nga naso yomohai ine Yerusarennu kemma kpetiac areng ihai kecdae, yeni memeficac wiac yemmebesonga anduae.
Kpetiac habu Yerusarennu kecdae, yenearunac goa makpekpea kecdae. Nga Makedonia nga Akaia habu yeneng yeneac ubamangang negemma memefic goa kpedzucnema faigecdeac degec.

Yeni ifi anggecdeac ayemmeec. Yerusarenggac kpebung yeneng Asuac wiac gombunga bangec monnunac ngicngac, yenearu mederema yemmegec bangec monnunac ngicngac, yeneac turunga anec. Imocac amma yeni yenang dzofinacngo meficgeyemmeude imocngo ngereede.
Ifi anu ubangerecnginaac fora imoc Yerusarennu mekemma yemmeba makpekpea yeneng imoc megecdeac singa meseribade. Imoc wisickeuguc ngenearu sing hama Spania bangecfu kembade.
Nga habade, naso imohai Kristoac kenec hafoangoc fede, imocgoc ngenearu habade, imoc negensiduae.
Negen negensinggoc tosofocna, ngeni Kebunina Yesu Kristoac amma Asungo heresongogoc kekec meficgenemmeande, yeac amma yofi edengunuduae, ngeni seriangoc meficnuma Anutu yofi numumibisia,

Yudaia bangecfu areng goa Kebu mi negensinggeandae, yeneac mariunac yeng onggonnuudeac numubisia. Amma ni memeficac wiac mehama kpetiac areng Yerusarennu kecdae, yeni imoc henggec ubangina ngereeude, imocac momoc numubisia.
Ifi ammagec Anutungo negenu ngereeu ngenearu hama sogac sogaigoc tacnegembade.
Anutu ruae minginango sasawa ngenigoc kecbeso, imoc fora.

footnotes.text: Spania imoc Inglis yoacfu sing Spain.
